description: Synthetic: a date-only purchase date (no time) after the case clock.
notes: Receipt-level case: invented data and no source. `purchasedAt` is a bare `YYYY-MM-DD`: such a date is in the future only when the day itself is after the clock's day (2027-01-15 > 2026-11-20), so FUTURE_DATE applies; a receipt dated 2026-11-20 would not be flagged.
The date is kept as printed, never corrected; the review UI is where the user decides.
